context._about: Facts the map needs that are not individual 2026 races. Sources: the Wikipedia Senate page's seat table and the gubernatorial page's infobox, read 2026-11-04.

senate.note: The 2 independents not up in 2026 caucus with Democrats.

runoffs._about: Dates of runoff elections, by state and office (H/S/G). Only from the state's official election site. A race with status 'runoff' and no entry here shows 'Headed to a runoff' without a date.

LA-H.note: Louisiana Secretary of State: 'December 12, 2026 - Open U.S. Representative General' (Act 7 of 2026). Read 2026-11-05.

updates._about: When the scheduled updates stop. After race_calls_end (Pacific time) the page shows a 'final snapshot' banner. If updates are restarted, move these dates too.
